notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Nim Deathmantle attached, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle and One with the Kami.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating at least two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
